newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Rent in arrears gives Kuwait tenant sore rear.
newsitem.headline: Rent in arrears gives Kuwait tenant sore rear.

text.p: An angry Kuwaiti landlord fired several rounds from a pistol at a tenant over delayed payment leaving him with two bullet wounds in his rear.
"A landlord fired five bullets at a tenant who declined to pay the rent of an apartment in his building. Two bullets injured his behind," al-Seyassah newspaper said on Thursday.
One bullet was removed while the other still rests in the rear of the tenant who refused to pay the rent or to adhere to an eviction order, it said.
